content: No, that is not true. Friedrich Dürrenmatt did not write that quote in his novel "Der Kommissar". The novel "Der Kommissar" was written by Georg Kaiser, not Dürrenmatt. Dürrenmatt is the author of works like "Der Besuch der alten Dame" and "Die Physiker", but not "Der Kommissar". The specific quote you mentioned is not associated with either of these authors in the context of that novel.
